# AD Design Kit changelog

Every change to the design system that came from Figma, newest first: tokens, theme modes, effect styles, component sets, variants and icons. Each version is a git tag (`ds-v<version>`), so the system can be checked out as it was at any of them.

Versions follow semver: anything removed or renamed is **breaking** (major), anything added is a minor version, changed values are a patch.

## 4.1.4 — 2026-11-05

**Tooltip and Popover wrap long content; Toast auto-dismiss is reliable; Card scrolls at a fixed height**

Patch · 3 changed · [Code](https://github.com/arvind988820398-ad/Figma-React-tailwind-sync/tree/ds-v4.1.4) · [Diff](https://github.com/arvind988820398-ad/Figma-React-tailwind-sync/compare/ds-v4.1.3...ds-v4.1.4)

**Code fixes**

- Changed `Tooltip and Popover always wrap their text (whitespace-normal text-start on the bubble and panel): long content inside a whitespace-nowrap table header or a centred row now breaks onto more lines at max-w-xs instead of running out of the bubble. New test story Tooltip / Long Content In No Wrap Parent.`
- Changed `Toast auto-dismiss keeps counting when the parent re-renders: the timer no longer restarts each time onDismiss is a new function, so `duration` is honoured in apps that re-render often (a streaming chat). New test story Toast / Auto Dismiss While Parent Rerenders.`
- Changed `Card: the content area can shrink (min-h-0), so a Card given a height (a side panel, a fixed tile) keeps it and lets its content scroll instead of overflowing. Cards that size to their content look the same. New test story Card / Fixed Height Scrolls.`

## 4.1.3 — 2026-11-05

**Production-ready package: floating panels, Next.js, any Node version**

Patch · 3 changed · [Code](https://github.com/arvind988820398-ad/Figma-React-tailwind-sync/tree/ds-v4.1.3) · [Diff](https://github.com/arvind988820398-ad/Figma-React-tailwind-sync/compare/ds-v4.1.2...ds-v4.1.3)

**Code fixes**

- Changed `Dropdown, Popover, Tooltip, Autocomplete and Datepicker are positioned with Floating UI: they flip and shift to stay on screen and are no longer clipped by a parent with overflow hidden (Table, Card, Drawer). New dependency @floating-ui/react-dom.`
- Changed `The npm package marks its interactive modules "use client", so it builds in the Next.js App Router; presentational components (Badge, Button, Card, Table…) stay Server Components.`
- Changed `The package no longer requires Node 24 to install (the requirement moved to devEngines, for this repository only).`
